acquisition: none: no exchange, news publisher, paid API or real user data
rights: original generated values and original template text; no third-party dataset reproduced
label_process: one Bernoulli draw per event from logistic(0.9 * uniform(-1.5, 1.5))
feature_process: latent signal plus seeded Gaussian noise; invented market probability adds further noise
text_process: original fixed bulletin template categorizes the observed signal, never the outcome
limitations: invented market probabilities are not observed exchange quotes
two snapshots of one event share one outcome and are not independent labels
no historical order books, trades, executable returns or empirical strategy evidence
exceptional payouts are demonstrated separately and never encoded as fractional binary labels
